responsibility: This machine-description support file centralizes NDS32 target constants that other .md files rely on: architectural register numbers such as $ta/$fp/$gp/$lp/$sp and the backend-wide UNSPEC/UNSPEC_VOLATILE enum values used to represent target-specific RTL operations. It provides the stable numeric tags that tie instruction patterns, expanders, predicates, TLS and PIC sequences, intrinsic operations, barriers, ISR support, unaligned accesses, DSP/FPU helpers, and other special NDS32 semantics together across the rest of the port’s machine descriptions.
